parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: "gemma4:31b", prompt: "You are a precise document transcription assistant. Look at this page visually and transcribe all text exactly as it appears, from top to bottom, left to right. Rules: 1. Transcribe all text verbatim — preserve numbers, symbols, currencies, dates, codes, and abbreviations exactly as written. 2. If there are images, charts, graphs, or diagrams, describe them in plain natural language within the flow of the text. 3. Ignore page numbers, headers, and footers unless critical to understanding the content. 4. Do not use Markdown formatting, bullet points, or stage directions. Return only plain text. 5. Do not summarize, explain, skip, or shorten any text. 6. End every sentence with a period. 7. For tables, first write one sentence summarizing what the table contains. Then transcribe each data row by pairing each cell with its column header, in the format \"Header: Value.\" for every column in that row, left to right. Repeat this for every row until the entire table is transcribed. Do not skip any rows or columns.", imageBase64: $json.imageBase64 }) }}

parameters.name: command
parameters.value: =export PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:$PATH && DUR=$(ffprobe -v quiet -show_entries format=duration -of csv=p=0 temp/{{$node["Process Pages One by One"].context.currentRunIndex + 1}}_audio.wav) && ffmpeg -y -loop 1 -t "$DUR" -i temp/{{$node["Process Pages One by One"].context.currentRunIndex + 1}}_image.png -i temp/{{$node["Process Pages One by One"].context.currentRunIndex + 1}}_audio.wav -vf "scale=trunc(iw/2)*2:trunc(ih/2)*2" -c:v libx264 -tune stillimage -c:a aac -b:a 192k -pix_fmt yuv420p temp/{{$node["Process Pages One by One"].context.currentRunIndex + 1}}_clip.mp4
